subject: BCP/DR evidence request — RTO/RPO snapshots and witness scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <security@hearthstone.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@hearthstone.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: BCP/DR evidence for SIG — RTO/RPO snapshots and witness

Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks again for taking the time on yesterday's call. As part of our SIG review and upcoming procurement window, the SOC2 team asked us to collect a short, timeboxed set of artifacts demonstrating current recovery posture. To avoid rework, can you provide the following by COB PT next Tuesday (Nov 2)?

Requested deliverables (focused scope):
- Current RTO and RPO for Redwood-hosted API, Redwood Dedicated pools, and Redwood Private (VPC) — include any variance windows and how sequential KV cache warm impacts measured RTO.
- A short excerpt (1–2 pages) from your DR runbook that shows the failover decision tree and primary recovery steps (redact hostnames if needed).
- Recent measurable evidence of an automated failover / warm-standby activation (timestamped logs or a test report) — ideally from within the last 12 months.
- A sampling of KV cache warm-up timings for typical customer model sizes (e.g., 7B, 13B, 70B) — indicate whether timings are with/without quantized kernels.
- Date of last tabletop and whether a live witness test can be scheduled (we would like a live witness window in Nov if possible).

If there are any constraints (third-party data, redactions, or embargoed test videos) note them and provide substituted artifacts. We also may request a short shared-screen session during the witness test.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Security Program Lead — Hearthstone Payments
security@hearthstone.com

Attachments: None

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <security@hearthstone.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence for SIG — RTO/RPO snapshots and witness

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes:

- We'll supply an RTO/RPO matrix broken out by deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private) including measured variance and the caveats around cache-dependent components.
- I will attach a redacted runbook excerpt and a recent tabletop report.
- For the automated failover logs, we have a warm-standby activation from 2027-06-17 (internal witness) and a simulated failover test from 2026-11; we'll include time-stamped extracts.
- KV cache warm-up samples for the model sizes you mention are available; we'll provide the CSV with per-model warm timing and kernel configuration.

Action plan and owners:
- Mina: assemble RPO/RTO matrix and extract timestamps (due Mon 10/1 EOD).
- Priya: redact runbook excerpt and pull tabletop report and logs (due Mon 10/1 EOD).
- Marcus: coordinate the witness scheduling and provide proposed windows for a live demo in Nov.

Are you able to do a 30-minute witness on Nov 10–12 or Nov 16–18? We can be flexible on times and will keep the live session scoped to the failover sequence and evidence review.

We'll upload artifacts to the Drive link and send a single packet your team can reference.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Reliability (Redwood Inference)
Attachments: rpo_rto_matrix.xlsx (planned)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Elena Gomez <security@hearthstone.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence for SIG — RTO/RPO snapshots and witness

Elena, Marcus — attached are the requested artifacts. Summary of what's included below and short clarifications where helpful.

Attachments in Drive (shared link included in email footer):
- rpo_rto_matrix.xlsx — tabbed by deployment mode, includes median and 95th percentile failover times observed during tests.
- runbook_excerpt.pdf — redacted decision tree + escalation contacts.
- tabletop_report_202706.pdf — summary and postmortem actions from June 2027 rehearsal.
- kvcache_warm_timings.csv — measured per-model warming times; column indicates kernel/quantization profile.
- failover_log_extracts.txt — timestamped events for the 2027-06-17 warm standby activation.

Key clarifications:
- RTO for hosted API (typical): median 90s, 95th perc 420s — warm cache reduces first-token latency but does not affect control-plane cutover; figures include path through autoscaling and warm pool attach delays.
- Dedicated pools: median 60s, 95th perc 240s — dedicated GPUs reduce scheduling variance.
- Private (VPC): depends on customer network routing; typical median 75s, 95th perc 360s — we include guidance on pre-warmed routing in the runbook excerpt.
- RPO: all modes report <60s for session KV serialization; full-state snapshots are nightly depending on customer config.
- KV cache warm: 7B ~12s, 13B ~27s, 70B (sharded) ~95–140s depending on quantization and kernel selection (see CSV).

Constraints and redactions: hostnames, IPs and internal operator IDs are redacted per our security policy. If Hearthstone requires unredacted artifacts for audit, we can route via an NDA + secure transfer.

Scheduling: Marcus — propose we lock a 45-minute witness on Nov 16 at 09:00 PT. We'll show the failover runbook walkthrough (5–10 min), replay of the 2027-06-17 log sequence (10 min), and a short live warm-attach demo (15–20 min).

Ping me if you want different windows.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf); kvcache_warm_timings.csv (csv); tabletop_report_202706.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Gomez <security@hearthstone.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@hearthstone.com, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence for SIG — RTO/RPO snapshots and witness

Marcus / Mina,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity — that packet looks good on first pass. A couple of follow-ups before the witness:

- We'll accept the redactions for now; procurement might request an NDA route for full artifacts — I will flag that.
- Nov 16 at 09:00 PT works for our security and SRE reps. Please send a calendar invite with the Drive link and a short agenda so we can circulate internally.
- For the live demo, please limit any active credentials or access tokens; a read-only witness path is preferred. We expect to observe the control-plane failover and KV attach traces — no access to customer data required.

If everything looks good I'll confirm invite and loop in our SRE lead, Mark Patel.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Security Program Lead — Hearthstone Payments
